messages:
zoe: FYI support ticket — user following the playground-react quickstart gets 402 on their very first API call even after adding a card in the UI.

zoe: repro steps from user:
```bash
# run quickstart
node playground.js
# quickstart uses fetch POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat
# Authorization: Bearer sk-live-...
```

zoe: response:
```json
{"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing inactive"}
```

ryan: org id / user email? did they create a new workspace or join an org?

zoe: org: org_R8m...q2, user: newbie@acme.com, they clicked Create workspace -> entered card -> console showed card ok and "billing enabled" (green).

billing-bot: Stripe webhook received: payment_intent.succeeded for pi_88y... at 2026-04-02T10:05:12Z. Billing link job queued: job_443 pending.

maya: sounds like the frontend confirmed before the backend link job finished. we've seen a transient where the link job fails if the browser session is closed quickly.

ryan: workaround for support: either run the admin link job or issue a temporary service token from Settings -> API tokens and retry. Also redwoodctl billing sync --org org_R8m...q2 will force reconciliation.

support-bot: admin action available: redwoodctl billing sync --org org_R8m...q2 -> queued by support.

zoe: ran sync -> output:
```
$ redwoodctl billing sync --org org_R8m...q2
Syncing billing... success. org billing status -> active
```

zoe: retried quickstart call after sync -> 200 and chat response returned. User confirmed app worked.

maya: filed prod bug #12012 — add server-side retry & make frontend await link confirmation. I'll also add a short note to the quickstart README about the transient and the support steps.

ryan: thanks. leaving this thread open until the deployment lands, but marking ticket as triaged.
